newsitem.title: USA: EquiMed completes purchase of businesses.
newsitem.headline: EquiMed completes purchase of businesses.

text.p: EquiMed Inc said it had completed its acquisition of several companies from its chairman and chief executive, Douglas Colkitt.

The company, which manages medical practices, said it paid $6 million in cash. It said it also planned a potential earn-out of up to $9.3 million payable in common stock in case combined annual pre-tax earnings from these companies reach an aggregate of $3.5 million in 1997.
"No earn-out will be due unless annual pre-tax income exceeds $1,000,000 in calendar 1997," it said, adding that the companies had combined 1996 revenues of $9.6 million.

The companies include Russell Data Services Inc, Trident International Accounting Inc, Billing Services Inc, Tiger Communications International LTD, and an 80-percent interest in Nittany Decisions Services Private Ltd.
They provide a range of services from outsourcing for accounting and billing to data processing and collections.
